_comment: Patient aliasing. A report is matched to a patient if ANY of: its patient external id is in external_ids, its (uppercased) pet name is in names, or its (uppercased) owner is in owners. First matching patient wins. Reports that match nothing get an auto-created patient keyed by their external id (or name+owner). Edit this file and re-run `bin/pethud reimport` to regroup.

patients.name: Iris
patients.notes: Same cat across two households; appears as IRIS REED and IRIS PARK.
